subject.title: fix(qa): unblock Matrix maturity scorecard runs

question: Should the Matrix/QA owner approve this protected QA-automation change after a current-main refresh and verification that the config-readiness and mock-voice paths preserve canonical Matrix maturity coverage?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and the environment could not perform the required current-source, scoped-policy, history, and artifact inspection needed for an independent merge verdict.

options.title: Approve after current-main verification

options.title: Request a narrower split
